title: The Careless line in the copy
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：careless　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 careless 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the keeper wrote of ① a careless line in the copy in the register, and everybody in the zoo said at once that it was ② more careless than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the careless ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most careless line in the copy anybody in the zoo had ever seen, or so the register for March 1978 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too careless to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the careless ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a careless wave of the hand, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as careless as the wave of the hand they had once had in the old zoo. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was careless or not, and he said so.

By 1991 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something careless, and nothing besides. The child from the next zoo called the whole plan ⑧ quite careless; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the careless ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1994, for the whole place, she wrote of another careless line in the copy in the same register, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more careless than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most careless wave of the hand in the whole zoo, she said in 1996, was the one she could never quite name; the careless ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 粗心（前置定语 a careless line in the copy：1984 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的那件粗心的一行）
B. adj. 粗心／漫不经心（比较级 more careless than：文中两处，一处比抄本里的一行，一处比预想）
C. adj. 粗心／漫不经心（最高级 the most careless：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 粗心（表语 too careless to do：母亲觉得它太粗心，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 漫不经心（前置定语 a careless wave of the hand：叔叔把整件事称作一桩漫不经心的一挥）
F. adj. 漫不经心（同级比较 as careless as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩随手的一挥相比）
G. adj. 漫不经心（后置定语 something careless：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 漫不经心（受程度副词修饰 quite careless：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a careless line in the copy
the most careless line in the copy anybody
a careless wave of the hand
The most careless wave of the hand in

answers.why: careless 意为“粗心”，1984 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的是“一件粗心的一行”，此处作前置定语 a careless line in the copy。
careless 意为“粗心”，此处用比较级 more careless than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
careless 意为“粗心”，饲养台账上 三月 那行字说它是兽舍里最粗心的一件，故用最高级 the most careless line in the copy。
careless 意为“粗心”，母亲认为这件东西“太粗心了，谁也用不上”，too careless to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
careless 意为“漫不经心”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩漫不经心的一挥”，此处作前置定语 a careless wave of the hand。
careless 意为“漫不经心”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩随手的一挥一样漫不经心”，同级比较用 as careless as。
careless 意为“漫不经心”，饲养台账上那半行字要的是“漫不经心的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something careless。
careless 意为“漫不经心”，邻兽舍来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当漫不经心”，quite 修饰原级 careless。
careless 意为“漫不经心”，1994 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要漫不经心”，故用比较级 more careless than。
careless 意为“漫不经心”，母亲 1996 年说的是“整个兽舍里最漫不经心的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most careless wave of the hand。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1984 年，饲养员在饲养台账里记下了一件粗心的一行。（a careless line in the copy）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更粗心。（more careless than …）
母亲觉得它太粗心，谁也用不上。（too careless to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩漫不经心的一挥。（a careless wave of the hand）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩随手的一挥一样漫不经心。（as careless as …）
到了 1991 年，饲养台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件漫不经心的东西。（something careless）
answers: In 1984 the keeper wrote of a careless line in the copy in the register.
Everybody said it was more careless than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too careless to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a careless wave of the hand.
He said nobody would call it as careless as the wave of the hand they had once had.
By 1991 the register asked for nothing but something careless.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 careless 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the keeper wrote of a careless line in the copy in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most careless line in the copy in the zoo, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too careless to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a careless wave of the hand, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next zoo called the plan quite careless, and everybody laughed.
The careless ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
